findings.why: Defines observation counts (52,64,37,49) and importer counts (4,7,4,5) in advance from the paper's Table, then invents a panel to hit those numbers exactly instead of building the sample by the paper's definition (importer-reported Rwanda HS 261100 mirror trade + FXTOP + global P^W). Subsequent code does: chosen_idx = rng.choice(len(cells), size=nobs, replace=False) / chosen = [cells[i] for i in chosen_idx] / lnX = imp_fe[imp] + beta*lnE + gamma*lnPw + eps / rows.append({...}) / panel = pd.DataFrame(rows). All 202 importer-months are synthetic draws; quantities, prices and world price lw_list are generated via random walk/noise, not UN Comtrade/FXTOP.
